subject: general
question: In which of the following period do the monsoon winds tentatively reach Punjab, Westerm Uttar Pradesh and Haryana during a normal monsoon year?
solution:
The correct answer is " **First week of July** ".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• During a normal monsoon year, the monsoon winds reach Punjab, western Uttar Pradesh, and Haryana in the** first week of July**.
 
• The monsoon winds are **pulsating** in nature and are affected by several **atmospheric conditions**.
 
• The duration of monsoon is usually between **100- 120 days**.
 
• It starts from **early June to mid-September**.
